criteria.justification: registry work_state is READY; recovery is proven at the Bridge layer but this requirement is not yet verified to acceptance

note: Recovery evidence is now owned on both layers. Agent Bridge proves restart, cancellation, session deletion, multi-process contention and forged-record recovery against real code (92 security/recovery tests, 23/23 mutations caught). The Aetherius owned-state layer adds verifiable backup/restore and a hash-linked event log, so a restored or replayed state is checked rather than believed. The gate stays IN_PROGRESS: REQ-p17-verification-continuity is still READY and unverified.
